note: The packages below are a SEED, not the whole covered set: tools/suidindex unions them with the owner of every setuid and setgid file the image carries, so a generated list also covers packages named nowhere here. A package with a url and a sha256 is one the base image does not install; the tool downloads it on the host, verifies the digest and bind-mounts it read-only into the container. A seed the image does not install and that pins no archive is dropped with a warning — the generator installs nothing, because a list has to be reproducible from the pinned image digest alone.
